title: curie seal --json
description: The agent-facing payload of `curie seal`: a connector credential encrypted to one cluster (ADR-0094). Every field is safe to commit -- the sealed blob is useless without the cluster's private key, and the public key is published by design. The plaintext value never appears.

connector.description: The connector in connectors.yaml that reads this value.

env_name.description: The environment variable name the connector reads it as.

sealed.description: Base64 of a NaCl sealed box. Safe to commit. Sealing the same value twice yields different blobs, so a repository's history does not reveal which credentials are equal.

public_key.description: The cluster public key this was sealed to, so an author can confirm which cluster can open it. Not a secret.

yaml.description: A YAML child fragment carrying the sealed value. Merge it under connectors.<name> in connectors.yaml so existing connector fields and sibling connectors remain intact.
